title: Quiet-Loud Pattern · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Quiet-Loud Pattern · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on three gentle claps, some quiet and some louder. The lead performs the three-clap pattern and the partner copies it. The partner repeats the quiet and louder claps in order. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Quiet-Loud Pattern, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The partner repeats the quiet and louder claps in order.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The partner repeats the quiet and louder claps in order.
